justification: Both surfaces show bearded male figures in strict profile with tall headgear, beard and hair rendered as regular stacked rows of curls, and garments with fringed/rosette detail, executed in the same low-relief convention with a rigid profile eye and heavy nose — a distinctive, conventional scheme rather than a generic 'human figure'. The chief difference is scope and composition: A is a single large bust-scale head with an earring and diagonal strap, while B shows a procession of smaller full-length figures interacting (a hand on a shoulder, held objects) framed between horizontal rosette bands.
